t: The Government appointed Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, Vice Chief of the Air Staff, as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff; he takes over on 31 October 2026 from Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh, who retires.
The World Bank's India Development Update (October 2026) projects India's economy to grow 7.1% in FY27 (2026-27).

On day one of the 2026 Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, India won 11 medals including four gold: Mona Agarwal (10m air rifle SH1), Nishad Kumar (men's long jump T47), Soumya (women's 1500m T12/T13) and Rinku (men's javelin F46).
The Union Cabinet approved the sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank (Government 30.48%, LIC 30.24%) to a Canadian subsidiary of Fairfax Financial Holdings for Rs 52,878.08 crore.
India's merchandise exports in September 2026 rose 23.04% year on year to USD 44.40 billion; imports were USD 74.61 billion and the merchandise trade deficit narrowed to USD 30.21 billion.
